channel.subtitle: GB28181 realtime channel status
channel.empty: No device specified, cannot load channels

field.name: Name
field.deviceIdHelp: Globally unique device ID, readable names like cam-rtsp-001 recommended
field.rtspUrlHelp: For RTSP/ONVIF devices, set the camera rtsp:// URL; ZLM pulls the stream on demand. Not used by GB28181 devices.
field.rtspSubUrlHelp: Optional. The device's second, lower-bitrate encoding (e.g. …/Streaming/Channels/102) for weak networks or multi-view grids; leave empty for main stream only.
field.orgHelp: Decides where this device sits in the upstream catalog. Empty means unassigned — devices auto-registered over SIP land here first.

section.queryHint: Asks the device for one snapshot: the reply is written into the device record and shown below in "Last reply" (not a switch — ongoing pushes are unaffected).

debug.title: Media Debug
debug.offline: Stream offline: metrics come from the media server and stop refreshing once the stream drops
debug.noRtcpTip: Neither the browser nor the media server exposes RTCP statistics; latency and packet loss require device-side support

msg.probeUrlRequired: Please fill in the RTSP URL first
msg.probeSubUrlRequired: Please fill in the sub-stream URL first
msg.liveHint: Pick a channel, then click LIVE to start previewing
msg.recordQuerySent: Record query sent; result will arrive via realtime events
msg.noPermission: You do not have permission for this operation
msg.eventsEmpty: No device events yet; device reports / responses appear here in realtime
msg.batchDeleteEmpty: Please select devices to delete first
msg.batchDeleteConfirm: Delete the selected {0} device(s)? The backend first revokes their catalog reports and only deletes channels and the devices themselves after every upstream platform confirms. Nothing is deleted if any platform stays unconfirmed.
msg.channelDeleting: Revoking the report and deleting channel {0} … (waiting for upstream confirmation, up to 10s)
msg.channelBatchConfirm: Delete the selected {0} channel(s)? Reported channels are revoked from the upstream catalog first and deleted locally only after it confirms.
msg.channelBatchPartial: {0} channel(s) deleted, {1} not deleted (upstream did not confirm the revocation)
msg.clearOfflineConfirm: Clear all offline channels of this device? Reported ones are revoked from the upstream catalog first; channels whose revocation is not confirmed stay. This cannot be undone.

events.captureNote: Only events received since this device detail opened; closing the drawer clears the list (SSE is push-only, not persisted)
events.empty: No events yet — device reports and replies show up here in real time

snapshot.title: Last reply
snapshot.noReply: No reply from device: check that it is online and signaling is reachable
snapshot.empty: No reply of this kind yet — use the query buttons above
